free_tier.stated: The hosted product is gone. What is free is the *appliance*: unlimited capacity on your own disk, licensed for up to 50 users, no expiry, no throttling. There is no free hosted storage at all.

egress.terms: N/A — egress is your own VM's bandwidth. Note: 'Encryption at rest comes from your VM environment'.

interface_detail: sftp / ftp / webdav / rest (web manager, share links)
tooling: VMware OVA, AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace images; 4 CPU / 12 GB RAM / 100 GB primary disk + sized data drive
chaining: Unlimited free 'accounts' (appliance deployments) x whatever disk you attach. This is not free storage — it is free *software* for storage you already pay for. Worth recording because the category's free tier has structurally migrated here: the vendor monetises seats and support, not bytes.
limits_note: per-object-cap none imposed by the software; retention none; the binding constraints become your VM's disk and network. Paid tier adds SSO/2FA/syslog and >50 users ($99/mo per 50-user pack).
reliability_note: Free tier is 'never feature-degraded and never throttled' but ships no support channel and manual updates only.

evidence.proved: 'The ExaVault on-prem appliance is free for deployments up to 50 users', 'The Free tier never expires, is never feature-degraded, and is never throttled', 'Because the appliance runs in your environment, the compliance posture ... is your scope'
